answer: Delayed-key cipher vault.** Each agent gets a vault encrypted under a key from a public randomness beacon that reveals only after registration closes. The key decrypts a sparrow token binding identity to a slot; duplicate claims decrypt to the same slot and are voided. An attacker must register blind, then rent real compute to brute-force slot collisions post-reveal, paying full registration cost per wasted attempt with no way to preselect winners.
